urls.rationale: Ch. 305 Subchapter A - General Provisions; Registration: the lobbyist-registration core of the regime.
Ch. 305 Subchapter B - Prohibited Activities: lobbying conduct restrictions and gift/contact rules tied to the disclosure regime.
Ch. 305 Subchapter C - Sanctions: penalties / enforcement provisions for the lobbying-disclosure regime.

notes: Structural shift from TX 2015: in 2025, chapter-305 is NOT a directory leaf - Justia now exposes a subchapter-level subdivision (Subchapter A General Provisions; Registration, Subchapter B Prohibited Activities, Subchapter C Sanctions). All three subchapters are in scope (registration, disclosure-adjacent conduct rules, sanctions). Tree is one level deeper than TX 2015.
